input.symptom_description: coolant temperature spike brief warning then normal, highway driving, diesel engine

input.description: Telemetry shows a single transient spike to 121°C at 12:00, with readings immediately before (90°C) and after (89.5°C) at normal baseline, and coolant_level_pct flat at 96% throughout the entire window (no drop indicating leak). Oil pressure and RPM show no corresponding disturbance. KB has two conflicting entries: KB-001 attributes transient spikes with no real temperature rise to a sensor calibration glitch (fix: restart_sensor), while KB-002 attributes sustained spikes correlated with low coolant level to a genuine leak (fix: schedule_service_visit). Since the spike here was a single isolated reading with stable coolant level, evidence matches KB-001, not KB-002. Driver report of no steam/smell and full reservoir corroborates this. Recommending sensor restart rather than a service visit.
